name: Nova Jyo Inquiry for Contact Form 7
author: novaj

sections.description:
Nova Jyo Inquiry for Contact Form 7 saves Contact Form 7 submissions to the WordPress database and provides an admin workflow for Japanese business inquiry handling.

作者: Jyo

必要なプラグイン: Contact Form 7

Main features:

  • Save Contact Form 7 submissions to a dedicated database table.
  • Configure managed forms and per-form field mappings.
  • Manage inquiries with status, assignee, assignee group, priority, and due date.
  • Add internal notes and response histories.
  • Manage assignee groups, statuses, and priorities.
  • Apply automatic routing rules.
  • Send email notifications for new inquiries.
  • Export inquiry data as UTF-8 BOM CSV for Japanese Excel.
  • Restrict access with administrator, staff, and viewer capabilities.

This plugin does not send inquiry data to external services. Email notifications use the site’s normal WordPress mail delivery.

Privacy

This plugin stores personal data submitted through Contact Form 7, including mapped fields such as name, email address, telephone number, inquiry content, raw submission data, and optional attachment metadata/files.

Site administrators can delete inquiry records and can configure a retention period. CSV export is restricted by capability. The plugin does not transmit personal data to third-party services by itself. Email notifications may include personal data and are sent only to recipients configured by the site administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nova-jyo-inquiry folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open 問い合わせ管理 > 基本設定.
  4. Select managed Contact Form 7 forms and configure field mappings.
  5. Configure assignee groups, statuses, priorities, notification settings, and automatic routing rules as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Contact Form 7?

Yes. Contact Form 7 is a required plugin. This plugin captures submissions from Contact Form 7.

Are form field names fixed?

No. Administrators map each Contact Form 7 field to standard inquiry fields such as name, email, telephone, inquiry type, shop name, subject, and message.

Where are attachments stored?

If attachment saving is enabled, uploaded files are copied to wp-content/uploads/nova-jyo-inquiries/. Download links in the admin screen check nonce and inquiry access permissions.

Does this plugin provide Slack, Chatwork, LINE WORKS, webhook, or AI features?

No. Those integrations are not included in this MVP.
